model.reason: Capital Spaceport at Eris cell $87: the captured interior selects region 1 of this same structure, with local X 840–1560 and Z -760–760. Exterior, interior layout and combined views are available. The interior layout follows region 1 source face ordering. Its $FF entry identifies the authored dynamic entrance-door attachment. The exterior and combined views select the authored open-window and open-door surrounds rather than overlapping them with closed facades. Open and closed detail endpoints are available for inspection; the recovered dynamic door motion, timing and retreat behaviour are not simulated. The closed panel is visible from both sides for inspection. Original region-dependent detail visibility is not fully simulated. Ordinary walls are shown from both sides for inspection; their source records do not specify polygon winding. The blue floor and cyan lower window wall are consistent with the supplied original-game interior view. See docs/research/damocles-spaceport-interior.md. Region queues and linked detail lists recovered for on-foot drawing; each region is also offered as its own inspection form, using the detail group default list because a free-orbit view has no player position. Entrance Attachments carry constructor, slot and Proximity Box.
